decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from expressjs/body-parser PR #741, merged 2026-07-07, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Each parser coerced a non-number limit through bytes.parse and kept the null result on failure — an invalid limit (unparsable string, NaN, boolean, object) silently disabled body-size enforcement, failing open. The fix (4 files, system complexity: lib/types/json.js, raw.js, text.js, urlencoded.js) validates the parsed limit and throws TypeError at middleware creation, keeping the 100kb default for absent/null. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (0defdbe7) to lib/ + index.js + package.json + LICENSE; runtime deps come from the per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:bodyparser-741 (node-ts + npm install of the repo's package.json via NODE_PATH — CJS, so NODE_PATH applies; built with the task repo as docker context). Coverage: 2 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — all four parsers times four invalid spellings throwing TypeError (exception TYPE only), plus a fail-open guard; 3 pass_to_pass guards drive the middleware over loopback node:http servers, pinning valid string limits parsing JSON, numeric limits enforcing 413 on oversized bodies, and the default limit. No message-text assertions.

fail_to_pass.name: invalid_throws
fail_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='vb invalid limits throw TypeError at creation for every parser' vb_limit.test.cjs

fail_to_pass.name: never_unlimited
fail_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='vb invalid limit is never silently unlimited' vb_limit.test.cjs

pass_to_pass.name: valid_string
pass_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='vb valid string limit accepted and parses json' vb_limit_reg.test.cjs

pass_to_pass.name: numeric_enforced
pass_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='vb numeric limit accepted and enforced' vb_limit_reg.test.cjs

pass_to_pass.name: default_limit
pass_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='vb default limit parses ordinary bodies' vb_limit_reg.test.cjs
